Md. Siddique Ali Mondal ----- Respondent
full_judgment:
“The learned Counsel for the defendant-petitioners submits that the plaintiff filed the suit on November 18, 1993 seeking decree that the order dated October 21, 1991 for illegally reducing his pay to Tk. 4000/- from Tk. 7,500/- and the subsequent order dated November 18, 1991 terminating his service are illegal, in operative, arbitrary and not binding upon him and for the declaration that he is still in the service of the defendant No. 1, the insurance company and he is entitled to be reinstated in the service with all arrear pay and allowances etc. and the suit was dismissed by the trial Court and on appeal the decree was reversed and by the proposed amendment dated 2nd April, 2000 a decree for an amount of Tk. 70,48,500/- as compensation for loss on account of illegal termination of the plaintiff as is barred under the law of limitation, the High Court Division has committed serious error in allowing the amendment of plaint during hearing of the Rule by filing an application for amendment of plaint on 2nd April 2000 sought for a decree for compensation of Tk. 70,48,500/-, the prayer for decree for realization of compensation made on 2nd April, 2000 being barred by law of limitation the High Court Division committed error of law by allowing amendment. The learned Counsel further submits that the plaintiff framed the suit for declaration and he prayed for the decree that he is entitled to be reinstated in the service with all arrear pay and allowances and did not sue in respect of any other relief the amendment of plaint converting the suit into a suit for compensation and praying decree an amount of TK. 70,48,500/- on account of compensation being a suit for in respect of claim which the plaintiff omitted or relinquished in the suit and as such the amendment sought for and allowed barred by the Rule 2(2) of Order II of the Code of Civil Procedure, the High Court Division committed illegality in allowing the amendment. The learned Counsel also submits that the suit as filed initially was a suit for declaration and by the amendment allowed the suit has been changed to a suit for compensation and the High Court Division committed illegality in allowing the amendment of plaint changing the entire nature and character of the plaint as well as the suit. The learned Counsel lastly submits that by the amendment plaintiff has introduced a totally new case for adjudication in the suit. 

 8. Mr. Md. Asaduzzaman, the learned counsel appearing for the appellants submitted that plaintiff filed the suit on November 18, 1993 seeking decree that the order dated October 21, 1991 for illegally reducing his pay to Tk. 4,000/- from 7,500/- and the subsequent order dated November 18, 1991 terminating his service are illegal, inoperative, arbitrary and binding upon him and for the declaration that he is still in the service of the defendant No. 1 the insurance company and he is entitled to be reinstated in the service with all arrear pay and allowances etc. and the suit was dismissed by the trial Court and on appeal the decree was reversed and by the proposed amendment dated 2nd April, 2000 a decree for and amount of Tk. 70,48,500/- as compensation for loss on account of illegal termination of the plaintiff is barred under the law of limitation, the High Court Division has committed serious error in allowing the amendment of plaint during hearing of the Rule by filing an application for amendment of plaint on 2nd April 2000 sought for a decree for compensation of Tk. 70,48,500/-, the payer for decree for realization of compensation made on 2nd April, 2000 being barred by law of limitation, the High Court Division committed error of law by allowing amendment and as such the judgment and order of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside. The learned Counsel further submits that the plaintiff framed the suit for declaration and he prayed for the decree that he is entitled to be reinstated in the service with all arrear pay and allowances and did not sue in respect of any other relief and the amendment of plaint would convert the suit into a suit for compensation and praying decree for an amount of Tk. 70,48,500/- on account of compensation being a suit for in respect of claim which the plaintiff omitted or relinquished in the suit and as such the amendment sought for and allowed barred by the Rule 2(2) of Order II of the Code of Civil Procedure, the High Court Division committed illegality in allowing the amendment and hence the judgment and order of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside The learned Counsel also submits that the suit as filed initially was a suit for declaration and by the amendment allowed the suit has been changed to a suit for compensation and the High Court Division committed illegality in allowing the amendment of plaint changing the entire nature and character of the plaint as well as the suit and as such the judgment and order of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside. 

 15. The amendment is not an introduction of a totally different new cause of action or its effect would be to substitute one distinct cause of action or its effect would be to substitute one distinct cause of action for another or change the nature and character of the suit. The plaintiff is also entitled to claim alternative relief by way of amendment as in the case of a alternative relief claiming of the damages or compensation is permissible even if it is barred by limitation. 

 16. The Court's power is not circumscribed by the law of limitation in its operation. The amendment, otherwise, would be allowed if the Court allows amendment even after the expiry of the period of limitation, the amendment of plaint will still deemed to have been presented when the original plaint was filed.
